name: Vryn
description: Vryn is Jace Beleren's home plane, a rainy plane covered in inhabited mage-rings.

summary.text: Vryn is Jace Beleren's home plane, a rainy plane covered in inhabited mage-rings.

bio.text: Jace was born on Vryn, and Alhammarret took him as an apprentice at thirteen, until Jace destroyed Alhammarret's mind and erased his own memories of it.

bio.text: When phyresis reclaimed Jace's body it planeswalked to Vryn, where his Phyrexian self seized dozens of soldiers.

bio.text: His mother Ranna healed him and Vraska there, and he and Vraska plotted the rebirth of the Multiverse.

citations.text: "Vryn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Vraska and Ranna raise Loot there, and they held a funeral for Jace on Vryn.

citations.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest stories Vryn is where Vraska and Ranna Beleren live, after Jace's funeral, and Tam visited Vraska there.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren is born on Vryn.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren is born in Silmot's Crossing on Vryn .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret takes Jace as an apprentice at thirteen.
timeline.quote: Alhammarret took Jace from his father and allowed him to become his apprentice at age thirteen.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that his spark ignited a year earlier and that Alhammarret lied to him.
timeline.quote: He discovered that his spark had ignited over a year ago, dipping him into the Blind Eternities only for a moment.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace destroys Alhammarret's mind in rage.
timeline.quote: He slipped into Alhammarret's mind and unleashed all of his rage and pain at once, destroying his master's mind.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace erases his own memories of what he had done.
timeline.quote: Jace erased his memories so that he would never have to see his teacher's face again

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the revised origin, Alhammarret is revealed as a sphinx arbitrating between Vryn's warring factions.
timeline.quote: Alhammarret was revealed to be a sphinx who arbitrated between the two warring factions of Vryn.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Revised origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace chokes out the name Vryn as a memory of his home plane floods in.
timeline.quote: He choked out a single word.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of Jace's mother reading to him as a toddler.
timeline.quote: She was reading to her toddler from a notebook as she wandered the tiny kitchen

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees that Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks and mentally violated every time he remembered.
timeline.quote: the realization he had been forced to forget his first planeswalk

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska experiences Jace's memory of facing the sphinx Alhammarret on a rooftop.
timeline.quote: the sphinx Alhammarret was crouched to attack in front of her.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace's mind-strike collapses Alhammarret's mind in a catastrophic implosion (flashback).
timeline.quote: What was a well of weathered marble violently collapsed against itself in a catastrophic implosion that deafened the senses.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace's own memories are ripped away in the psychic backlash.
timeline.quote: But Jace had struck out too hungrily, too hard, and his own memories were ripped away in the process of psychic demolition.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret, mind destroyed, screams like an infant.
timeline.quote: It was the terrified howl of an infant.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace instinctively planeswalks away, losing more memories as he goes.
timeline.quote: Jace began to instinctively planeswalk away

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Only the image of the sphinx's collar symbol remains in Jace's memory.
timeline.quote: All that remained was the image of the sphinx's collar

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace defies the oil and removes his compleation components.
timeline.quote: he forcefully removed the physical components of his compleation

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Uncompleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ranna burns most of the oil from Vraska, curing her.
timeline.quote: she burned most of the oil away and regenerated new tissue

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes she has lost her planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Vraska realized that she had lost her planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's body planeswalks to Vryn as phyresis reclaims him.
timeline.quote: His body exits the aether of the Blind Eternities and steps onto the wet soil of a plane he hasn't seen in years.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace briefly sees through his body's eyes at Vryn, where his Phyrexian self has seized dozens of soldiers.
timeline.quote: Twenty soldiers seize in front of him, their minds singing to Jace's in a static cacophony.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace commands his body to sleep and succeeds.
timeline.quote: YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in a ravine feverish, tears out a cable from his arm and decides to save Vraska.
timeline.quote: he grasps one of the cables in his arm and rips it out.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska collapse in the home of Jace's mother Ranna, a healer.
timeline.quote: Ranna Beleren, ever in control, hides her alarm at the bleeding monsters that fell into her living room.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace pleads with his mother for help before passing out.
timeline.quote: Please help us, Mom. I'm so sorry.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: On Vryn, Ranna Beleren tends to Jace and Vraska, who arrive bleeding on her floor; Vraska asks her to save Jace first.
timeline.quote: "Save him first," Vraska rasps

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Ranna telepathically asks whether Vraska is Jace's wife, and Jace answers that she is his world.
timeline.quote: She is my world, mother.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Ranna casts a ward and sedates the pair with a song.
timeline.quote: Ranna whispers to them both a song of sedation

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in his old bedroom and explains he gave them fevers to burn out phyresis; Ranna reveals Vryn thought he died with Alhammarret.
timeline.quote: We all thought you died with him.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace shows his mother his memories, and she asks if he killed Alhammarret; his expression answers yes.
timeline.quote: Ranna nods for him. " Good ."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Ranna uses a phoenix feather to heal Vraska, and Jace learns his parents separated.
timeline.quote: It's a phoenix feather.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace overhears Ranna telling Vraska that the old her is dead, mentioning a warrant for Jace's execution.
timeline.quote: The old you is dead. You can never be that person ever again.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, disguised, visit an Omenpath on Vryn and decide something must be done about the portals.
timeline.quote: "Jace. We have to do something."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska decide the Multiverse is too broken to fix and settle on a rebirth plan inspired by phoenix feathers.
timeline.quote: "So, what if we do something other than fix it."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Over months they accept their old lives are over and agree that rebirth is the just option.
timeline.quote: But rebirth … rebirth does both.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Before leaving Vryn, Jace and Ranna say goodbye and promise weekly contact.
timeline.quote: "Once a week," Ranna says

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Vraska discovers she can no longer planeswalk, and Jace confirms her spark is gone.
timeline.quote: "I can't feel it. I can't feel it anymore."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace vows to make meaning of their own; Vraska plots their plan on the wall.
timeline.quote: She turns her grief into purpose with furious alchemy

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska plot the rebirth of the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: plotted a rebirth of the Multiverse

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Plotting the rebirth of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Vryn, Vraska and Ranna raise Loot and give him a basic education.
timeline.quote: On Vryn, Vraska and Jace's mother Ranna acted as parental figures for Loot, giving him a basic education.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska uses Loot's talents to map a way to the Echoverse from Vryn but does not bring him along.
timeline.quote: she used Loot's talents to map a way there from Vryn, but did not bring him along

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Ranna Beleren hold a funeral for Jace on Vryn.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Ranna Beleren hold a small funeral for Jace on Vryn.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Battle for the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani tell Vraska that Jace is still alive.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar and Ajani Goldmane walked through the front door bearing the news that Jace was still alive

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds a funeral for Jace on Vryn, and Tam asks for her help.
timeline.quote: Tam responded that she didn't know, but she hoped Vraska would help her find out

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Vraska on Vryn after the end of the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: Some time after the end of the Echoverse, Tam visited Vraska on Vryn , hoping for her help deciding what to do.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska lives with Ranna and Loot on Vryn, mourning Jace and wracked by guilt for turning away from him.
timeline.quote: Mostly what plagues her is guilt. She turned away from him.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
timeline.quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani explain that a gorgon working for Jace kidnapped an oracle, and Vraska deduces he needs knowledge of how planes fuse.
timeline.quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska agrees to help reach Jace, and Ranna entrusts her with a wrapped package for him.
timeline.quote: "Yes." Vraska nods, wincing.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
timeline.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska, traveling to Strixhaven by Omenpath, camps in a swamp and dreams of General Beleren.
timeline.quote: She is in the center of an alder-lined war room.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: In the dream, General Beleren says he is the part that frightens her, kisses her cheek and says he can be both a good man and a monster.
timeline.quote: His lips graze her cheek. "I can be both ."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska wakes and realizes Jace is both good and monstrous, and that she may have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: He is both , she realizes with mournful shame, with defiant fierceness.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Compelled by Alhammarret to step off the Vrynian rooftop, Vraska aims her fall at a portal and steps off.
timeline.quote: She was commanded to walk, but she was not commanded to aim, and so she aims.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: While falling, Vraska thinks of her divided selves and invites her assassin self to join her fall.
timeline.quote: she sees herself, the assassin, and invites her to join this fall.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier, a boy in a memory trap of a camp of dead soldiers, recognizes Vraska approaching and salutes her.
timeline.quote: The Soldier sees Vraska approaching and straightens into a salute.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier asks for help and admits he is the reason she could not love all of him.
timeline.quote: "I'm the reason you couldn't love all of me.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska embraces the Soldier and tells him she loves him as she loves Jace.
timeline.quote: You're part of him, and I love you as I love him."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier says death is a change in state and dives into Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: he soundlessly disappears his body and dives into her mind.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: After Jace's funeral, Vraska sits with Ranna Beleren as a quiet morning passes.
timeline.quote: He was laid to rest as a son of Vryn

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam arrives at Ranna's door, introduces herself to Vraska and says she is here to help make things better; Ranna drops her teacups on seeing Tam.
timeline.quote: "I'm here to help make things better."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vryn is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion; its denizens defeat the Phyrexians by overloading the mage-rings.
timeline.quote: defeated the Phyrexians by overloading the mage-rings

citation.text: "Vryn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Loot is on Vryn with Ranna Beleren.
relations.quote: Loot is currently on Vryn in the care of Vraska and Jace's mother, Ranna Beleren.
